children: Global Health acquires 10,560 sq metre freehold land parcel for ₹165.82 crore to expand its Delhi-NCR healthcare network

Global Health Ltd, which operates the Medanta hospital network, has acquired a 10,560 sq metre land parcel in Ghaziabad’s Siddharth Vihar for Rs 165.82 crore, with plans to potentially develop a 350-plus bed hospital, subject to statutory approvals and the company’s board approval.

The land was allotted by the Uttar Pradesh Housing & Development Board (UPAVP) on a freehold basis through an online auction. The proposed facility is expected to strengthen Medanta’s presence across the Delhi-NCR healthcare market and expand access to tertiary and quaternary care in Ghaziabad and neighbouring areas.

Ghaziabad’s growing population, urbanisation, residential and commercial development and connectivity with Delhi-NCR have made the city an important healthcare catchment. The proposed Siddharth Vihar facility could also serve patients from eastern Delhi, Meerut, Saharanpur, Hapur, Bulandshahr and other parts of western Uttar Pradesh.

According to the company, the location provides an opportunity to develop an integrated healthcare facility while leveraging Medanta’s clinical expertise, technology, medical talent and existing healthcare ecosystem. “We see Ghaziabad as a compelling long-term healthcare opportunity within the broader Delhi-NCR market. The region has undergone significant urban and economic development and continues to see increasing demand for advanced, specialised healthcare services,” said Pankaj Sahni, Group CEO and Director, Global Health.

Sahni said the Siddharth Vihar parcel could provide a platform to develop a large integrated hospital and extend Medanta’s clinical capabilities to a wider patient catchment. The proposed hospital would also complement the company’s existing Medanta Noida facility, with the company looking to strengthen its healthcare network across eastern and central Delhi-NCR.

“The proposed hospital would also complement our existing presence through Medanta Noida, enabling us to strengthen our healthcare network across the eastern and central parts of the Delhi-NCR region,” Sahni added. The company said its focus would be on building a healthcare institution combining clinical expertise, experienced medical talent, technology and patient-centric care. The project remains subject to customary and statutory approvals as well as approval from Global Health’s board.
